findings.suggested_fix: Define a specific time threshold (e.g., 'within 2 seconds').
Define specific metrics for usability (e.g., '95% of users shall complete the registration process in under 2 minutes')
Define the specific duration or condition that constitutes 'too long' (e.g., 'if generation takes more than 5 minutes').
Define what the 'standard timeout' value is, or reference a specific requirement where it is defined.
Define the specific conditions or list of scenarios under which an administrator is permitted or required to deactivate a user account.
Specify the hashing algorithm (e.g., bcrypt, Argon2) and salt requirements (e.g., minimum length, generation method).
Define specific behaviors for error handling (e.g., 'The system shall log the error code and display a generic user message when an input validation error occurs').
Define 'major' by listing specific browser names and versions (e.g., Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) or referencing a standard like W3C recommendations.

Specify the source of truth for tax rates (e.g., 'using the tax rules defined in REQ-XXX' or 'applying the state and local tax rates associated with the shipping address as provided by the external Tax Service API').
Define what constitutes 'order history' (e.g., include cancelled orders, return records, etc.) or reference a specific data model definition.
Define the criteria or algorithm used to calculate relevance (e.g., 'based on keyword match count and publication date').
Define 'highly available' with specific metrics (e.g., 'The system shall have an availability of 99.9% during business hours').

findings.evidence: Customers should be able to cancel an order
findings.suggested_fix: Define the expected system behavior upon cancellation (e.g., 'The system shall update the order status to Cancelled and issue a full refund').
Define a specific time threshold for the update (e.g., 'within 500 milliseconds' or 'before the order confirmation page is displayed').
Specify the exact regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA) or reference a specific standard document.

findings.evidence: as described in the payment error handling section
findings.suggested_fix: Define the specific actions for failed payment attempts (e.g., 'log the error', 'notify the user', 'retry once') directly in this requirement or provide a link to a defined standard.
Define specific target dimensions or resolution criteria for the resized photos.
Specify the encryption standard or algorithm (e.g., 'shall encrypt sensitive data using AES-256').
Define which data fields or types constitute 'sensitive data' in the requirements glossary or related sections.

Define acceptable failure rates, recovery time objectives (RTO), or data durability guarantees (e.g., 'The system shall ensure zero data loss during normal operation and recover all committed transactions within 5 minutes of a single node failure').
